verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a headless CLI path built for automation: token auth through ARDENT_TOKEN with no login step, machine-readable JSON output and JSON errors with stable codes, idempotent re-runs, and an explicit CI/CD workflow that gives every PR its own branch, plus an API aimed at CI systems. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI/headless usage (all evidence is vendor docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Set ARDENT_TOKEN and run commands normally — no login step
ardent branch info my-feature --format json # prints a stable JSON object
Errors are JSON too, with a stable `code`
Your script or CI harness runs the CLI; the agent only ever sees a branch URL.
Every PR runs against its own fresh database branch cloned from your connected source
Use the API when you are building CI systems, internal developer platforms, custom dashboards, or agent workflows.
